newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy companies must invest to ensure growth-Fazio.
newsitem.headline: Italy companies must invest to ensure growth-Fazio.

text.p: Italian companies must increase their investments in plant and machinery if the economy is to return to an annual growth rate of three percent, Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio said on Saturday.

"Our economy can go back to growing at an annual rate of three percent. An additional, permanent increase of investments in equipment and machinery is necessary of at least one percentage point of (gross domestic) product, said Fazio.
Fazio was making an address at the Bank of Italy's annual assembly.
Fazio also said he expected sluggish economic growth and a grim outlook for jobs over the next three years while the government wrestled to contain the public sector deficit.
Italian investments abroad were low in proportion to the size of its economy.

"Our companies are little involved in international capital transfers. Foreign direct investments in Italy, but also those by Italians in other countries' companies, are slim in comparison with the size of the economy," he added.
Fazio attributed these problems to Italy's tax system and to the small size of its financial markets.
